# Vendored: @relate/relate-wasm 1.0.1

This folder is the unmodified npm package `@relate/relate-wasm@1.0.1`
(the Relate graph engine compiled to WebAssembly), copied here so the browser
view works from a fresh clone and from GitHub Pages with no build step.
The TypeScript `.d.ts` files were left out.

- Source: https://github.com/relatedb/relate (surfaces/relate-wasm)
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@relate/relate-wasm
- License: Apache License 2.0, https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
